generation.prompt:
A pixel-art character reference sheet for a game, redrawing four existing characters in a simpler, cleaner style.

Image 1 is the STYLE and SCALE target: match its pixel size, its simple big shapes, its flat clean colour clusters, its readable faces with clear eyes, its clean dark outline, its proportions (big head, about three heads tall, chunky body). Do not copy its characters.
Images 2, 3, 4 and 5 are the CHARACTERS to redraw, keeping who they are: hair, beard, face, clothing colours and silhouette, but with far less detail.

Layout: two rows of two characters, on a flat solid dark navy background (#1a2230), four views of each character side by side, in this order: front, three-quarter front, back, left profile. Plenty of empty background between figures, no figure touching another. No text, no labels, no numbers, no frame. No ground shadow.

Pixel grid: real pixel art on one regular grid, one art pixel = exactly 2 x 2 image pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradient, no dithering, about 24 colours for each character. Each figure is exactly 170 image pixels tall, 85 art pixels. The head is about 60 image pixels wide, as wide as the shoulders nearly, with large clear eyes.

Row 1, left: image 2, a grey-haired bearded champion knight in dark steel armour, a blue cape with a cream fur collar. Row 1, right: image 3, a young woman fighter with a red ponytail, a red scarf, light armour over a red and ivory tunic, tall brown boots.
Row 2, left: image 4, a big bearded northern mercenary with brown hair, a cream fur collar, a dark green cloak, brown leather. Row 2, right: image 5, a young knight with dark blue hair, plain steel armour, a blue cape.

Important: plain cloth. NO emblems, NO fleur-de-lis, NO crests, NO symbols, NO embroidery on any clothing, only a thin plain border on capes. No weapons in hand. Calm standing pose, arms slightly away from the body so they read clearly.
